pr_title: Use correct native type in test marshallers
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/93155.

The marshallers used in the CollectionMarshallingFails LibraryImport tests used nint as the native type which is larger than the native side uses as the native type. This caused us to "free" past the end of the allocated array. Since the marshaller's implementation of `Free` didn't check anything about the value, it wouldn't error on an unexpected value. This changes the marshallers to use types of the same size and checks that the values freed after `FillRange` and `FillRange2D` are the correct values, rather than just checking that `Free` is called the correct amount of times.

This also adds more validation to the CollectionMarshallingFails tests. Test methods now specify how many elements should be freed or what values are expected to be freed in addition to when the marshalling / unmarshalling failure should occur. This found a couple issues in jagged arrays (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/93431, https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/93423), which probably don't need fixing, but are good to know about.
